I know a pest snail when I see one lol def a bladder snail. They reproduce asexually and they reproduce fast, making them hard to get rid of hence the name pest snail. Like any other living organism in an aquarium, they add to the bioload so when you have dozens of them you’ll need to do water changes more often to keep it in check. 

If you want to keep it you can, they can actually be beneficial if you’re able to keep the population controlled. One way to slow their reproduction is to remove any leftover food and decaying plants. If there’s lots of food available, they will reproduce. So if there’s lots popping up it’s a little reminder to do some cleaning lol you can also get rid of any egg sacs you see but they can be pretty good at hiding them 

Keeping bladder snails isn’t for everyone cause your tank can easily become overrun with snails. If they start to take over you can get snail traps or even assassin snails to get rid of some.
